limitations: N07 finite 60-step ADMM failed stationarity criterion on all 11 informative pilot cases; retain only as budgeted approximate output, never an optimum claim.
N14 two pilot cases above 1e-5 projected-gradient threshold; disclose finite stationarity.
N11 removes real adipose interior; N03 categorical grid is visibly blocky.
RINGS negative is not stroma. Reference-unannotated tissue cannot establish anatomical accuracy.
No pilot ranking determines the full-cycle survivors.

bcss_18.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected against H&E, reference, coarse and RGB. Long green stromal bands persist; most methods bridge the narrow white clefts. N11 restores more branched white clefts, N12 fewer, M11 exposes peripheral cuts; this is also deletion risk. N03 has visibly stepped edges and small granules; N02 shifts broad red-green borders. N13 resembles controls; none restores all annotated lumina.
bcss_18.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

bcss_45.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Gold adipose left, green separator, violet immune stripe and red right largely preserved. C17 and N14 suppress small gold intrusions within violet more than K05/N07/N09. N01 and N02 broaden or distort intermediate strips; N03 edges are stepped. M11 exposes large fat spaces, N11 produces a conspicuous white lattice through gold adipose, N12 deletes less; N10 looks like J01. Unannotated upper-left tissue is still analyzed.
bcss_45.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

bcss_53.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Multiple dispersed red nests sit in green; the central-right red connection is too solid in several outputs. K05/N08/N09 and N01 fragment that connection somewhat while N02/N13 keep larger blocks; N03 adds stepped margins. N10/N11/N12 make little visible change on this dense tissue. No algorithm recreates every thin annotated green separation.
bcss_53.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

bcss_87.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Original small red and gold islands are blurred in RGB; every method leaves too much contiguous violet at upper right and misses the intricate green network. C17/N14 have fewer gold fringes and a larger connected green centre. N03 has granular stair-step contours; N01/N07/N09 produce scattered violet extensions rather than the reference network. Glass children look effectively unchanged in this dense field.
bcss_87.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

tiger_23.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Cyan left, grey top right, green middle and violet bottom right. N13 markedly expands grey far into violet and loses the green divider; N14 and N15 partly share that shift. N03 is stepped. J01/M04/N04/N05/N06 retain a clearer green separator; K05/N07/N08/N09 change its thin branches. Shared lower-right white slits persist, glass variants add little.
tiger_23.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

tiger_32.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Gold fat left, diagonal small red nests in green, blue top-right. Every method misses or merges many reference thin red strands; N07/N09 enlarge some red islands, N02 and N15 create thicker red connections. C17/N13 preserve broad control geometry. White removal remains mainly peripheral; no clear inner-fat deletion in this image. N03 diagonal boundary shows visible steps.
tiger_32.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

rings-tumor_01.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Binary tumour boundary is confined to the right; green means outside tumour, not expert stroma. J01/M04/N04/N05/N06 keep the right red body comparatively clean, K05/N01/N07/N09 produce extra central red specks and some red-border holes. N13/N14/N15 show stronger central false red. Shared lower-left lumen deletion remains; N11 adds another white left-border pocket. N10 resembles J01.
rings-tumor_01.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

rings-tumor_03.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. The frozen RGB and coarse mask are constant green although original H&E has complex glands. All methods retain the same single-class coarse fallback, apart from white support/removal details. N11 expands the top white cleft and N12 differs slightly at border. A perfect binary score here demonstrates an outside-tumour example, not architectural reconstruction or newly discovered gland classes.
rings-tumor_03.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

wsss4luad_01.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Red epithelial masses and green connective areas are much smoother than reference thin rims around lumina. Most white lumina are filled by class predictions; this reference white is ignored, not necessarily algorithmic background error. N01/K05/N07/N09 break a few middle-right red-green connections; N03 is blocky with jagged steps. N02/N13 are closer to broad hard-colour control regions. Glass children cannot recover fine internal gaps absent shared support.
wsss4luad_01.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

wsss4luad_04.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Constant red converted RGB activates the common frozen fallback: the small coarse green corner is retained, all other pixels red. No method resolves the white gland spaces or the true curved green lower-left border. This is explicitly a no-information example; identical masks are not new successful refinement.
wsss4luad_04.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

ocelot_01.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Green connective branches between red glands are too sparse compared with reference; most outputs merge the upper-centre red glands. N01/N08/K05/N09 expand several green islands slightly. N02 and N13 form broader green pockets but still miss long thin strands. N03 produces stepped strands. No visible white-removal gain from N10/N11/N12 on this dense tissue.
ocelot_01.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

beetle_01.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Fine reference covers only a central small island plus lower strip; whole tissue is still predicted. Grey regions outside the reference cannot be validated here. K05/N08/N09 split grey and red more than J01/M04; N13 expands grey locally, N03 is visibly angular. All methods leave most internal H&E lumina assigned red or grey; peripheral original background is excluded.
beetle_01.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

camelyon16-subset_01.observation: All 22 overview masks inspected. Small red tumour masses lie top and bottom; the broad green outside-tumour territory contains much fat. C17/N14/N15 keep more compact red shapes. N11 creates extensive new white holes through adipose at upper-right and left, beyond the shared peripheral holes; N12 removes less but still changes some edge spaces. N10 matches J01 broad support; none restores expert smooth tumour contours fully.
camelyon16-subset_01.review_scope: contact-sheet overview; native-resolution zooms must be noted separately

bcss_45/native-review/0-0-256-256.observation: All 22 native-crop label panels inspected. Fine reference is absent here. H&E shows fat-cell walls; shared support leaves a lace of gold crossing cell interiors rather than faithfully tracing all walls. M11/N11/N12 replace much of this with coarse white voids and simple gold struts. N10 does not restore common lost support. Neither morphology can be judged correct from absent reference.
bcss_45/native-review/0-0-256-256.actual_view: Native-resolution label crop sheet; every displayed method

tiger_23/native-review/640-640-256-256.observation: All 22 native-crop labels inspected. Reference green centre and violet wedge right; N13 adds a broad false grey field with two disconnected grey islands, N14/N15 add grey rims. J01/M04/N04/N05/N06 retain the green-violet interface with no grey band. K05/N07/N08/N09 move the wedge left. N03 creates sharp cell-sized block steps and a vertical isolated violet sliver.
tiger_23/native-review/640-640-256-256.actual_view: Native-resolution label crop sheet; every displayed method

rings-tumor_01/native-review/640-640-256.observation: All 22 native-crop labels inspected. Reference is valid negative throughout this window, although glands are present. C17/N13/N14/N15 and B21/B22 create multiple sizable false red islands; N01/K05/N07/N08/N09 leave smaller red islands. J01/M04/N04/N05/N06/M11/N10/N11/N12 largely suppress the false detections. This is binary tumour specificity, not proof of stroma identity.
rings-tumor_01/native-review/640-640-256.actual_view: Native-resolution label crop sheet; every displayed method
